status: source-inspected adaptations; not original-paper reproductions or proven novel contributions

sources.name: DSANet
sources.use: Frozen trained anchor, native SGNM prototype aggregation, official evaluation.
sources.local_modifications: Existing local option/train/dataset changes are retained, not newly introduced by expansion. Exact runtime is SHA256-recorded, not identified by upstream commit alone.

sources.name: DiGIT
sources.title: DiGIT: Multi-Dilated Gated Encoder and Central-Adjacent Region Integrated Decoder for Temporal Action Detection Transformer
sources.change: Single identity-initialized masked multi-dilated gated residual per independent VAD head. No supervised proposal decoder, custom CUDA, or full DiGIT reproduction.

sources.name: ASOT
sources.title: Temporally Consistent Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
sources.change: Log-domain structural soft targets with video-allowed classes, background, anchor-derived nonuniform marginal, and normal-residual-gated temporal edges; training only. Not the official unsupervised clustering pipeline.

sources.name: ConsMTL
sources.title: Towards Consistent Multi-Task Learning: Unlocking the Potential of Task-Specific Parameters
sources.change: Primary-directed semantic-head mixed derivative with detached binary reference and capped extra head gradient; does not implement symmetric bargaining or reproduce full ConsMTL.

sources.name: PCGrad
sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
sources.use: Prior art for conflicting-gradient projection; P6 uses a one-sided primary-priority variant with an auxiliary norm budget.
